name: Seated Forward Fold
description: Hinge forward over the legs from sitting to stretch the hamstrings while keeping the back long.

items.content: Sit tall with legs in front and knees and toes facing upward.
Bend the knees or sit on a folded blanket if needed to keep the pelvis upright.
Tip forward from the hips, reaching the chest toward the feet without forcing the back to round.
Rest hands on the legs or floor; avoid pulling hard on the feet.
Hold a mild stretch with easy breathing, then return upright slowly.

stages.name: Hold
stages.description: Seated with legs together in front, knees slightly bent and toes upward. Torso leans forward from the hips, spine long and hands resting on the shins.
